Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1378
Claimant:
Carla Franco
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
12-5-23
First notice of loss received from the insured's agent reporting a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a second
vehicle backing out of a space. The claimant is named as the injured party and is represented by counsel, so all
contact will go through the attorney's office.
12-12-23
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of the loss. No issues with the
policy terms have been identified at this stage.
1-29-24
Spoke with the other driver, who gave an account matching the insured's description of how the impact happened.
The other driver also said they did not see the claimant's vehicle until contact was made.
2-12-24
Reviewed photographs submitted by the insured. The visible damage to the front of the insured vehicle and the rear
of the other vehicle is largely consistent with the impact described in the reports.
2-28-24
Obtained statements from two witnesses who were in the lot at the time. Both independently described the backing
vehicle striking the claimant's car at low speed.
3-9-24
Attorney's office sent a letetr confirming representation and requesting that the claim be handled in writing.
Acknowledged receipt and noted the file.
5-18-24
Recorded a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The claimant described the same sequence of
events as in the first report and gave a consistent account of the impact.
5-23-24
Received the initial medical records describing a knee injury. The reported injury appears plausible given the nature
of the collision, and no prior treatment to the same body area is shown in the records reviewed so far.
5-31-24
Noted that the claimant's seating position at the time of impact is not fully clear from the statements. Requested
additional information from counsel to clarify this point.
6-19-24
Reviewed the vehicle repair estimate. No earlier damage to the veihcle has been identified in prior claim history or
inspection notes, and nothing suggests the damage predates the policy start date.
6-21-24
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of knee injury. Requested updated treatment
notes and a treating physician's summary to understand the course of care.
7-19-24
Summary review in progress. Liability appaers clear from the consistent accounts and physical evidence, and the file
will be referred for injury evaluation once the requested medical and seating-position information is received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
